items.title: Constituent Assembly speech — 17 December 1946 (excerpt)
items.description: An excerpt from Ambedkar’s intervention during the Constituent Assembly discussion. He distinguishes agreement about the eventual goal from the difficulty of making a beginning and bringing parties and sections together.
items.source_label: Dr. Ambedkar Foundation, Government of India (Wayback archival copy)
